verdict.rationale: monday.com's docs describe AI agents that surface insights, spot risks/progress gaps, automate status/performance reports, and summarize calls/extract action items directly within boards and dashboards, which aligns with in-product AI-generated insights. However, this is entirely vendor-sourced marketing copy with no independent/hands-on corroboration of insight quality or accuracy, and community feedback focuses on general product usability rather than AI insight features specifically. Missing for 10: independent verification of insight quality/accuracy, concrete examples of generated insights, and hands-on user reports confirming the feature works as described.
